-- GA's configuration, with value converters
DO $EF$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'ef_ga') THEN
        CREATE SCHEMA ef_ga;
    END IF;
END $EF$;


CREATE TABLE ef_ga."IconicChords" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "Name" text NOT NULL,
    "PitchClasses" text NOT NULL,
    "GuitarVoicing" text,
    "AlternateNames" text NOT NULL,
    "LastUpdated" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_IconicChords" PRIMARY KEY ("Id")
);


CREATE INDEX "IX_IconicChords_Name" ON ef_ga."IconicChords" ("Name");

-- the same entity, without converters
DO $EF$
BEGIN
    IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'ef_native') THEN
        CREATE SCHEMA ef_native;
    END IF;
END $EF$;


CREATE TABLE ef_native."IconicChords" (
    "Id" integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY,
    "Name" text NOT NULL,
    "PitchClasses" integer[] NOT NULL,
    "GuitarVoicing" integer[],
    "AlternateNames" text[] NOT NULL,
    "LastUpdated" timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "PK_IconicChords" PRIMARY KEY ("Id")
);


CREATE INDEX "IX_IconicChords_Name" ON ef_native."IconicChords" ("Name");
